Launch Interactive Vantor Explorer Demo Shiny App

Source: R/vantor_shiny.R
run_vantor_demo_app.Rd

Launches a standalone Shiny application combining vantor_auth_ui() and vantor_explorer_ui() for interactively browsing Vantor Vivid basemaps, inspecting seamline acquisition dates, monitoring account usage, and exporting GeoTIFFs.

Usage

run_vantor_demo_app(
  initial_bbox = c(xmin = -105.01, ymin = 39.73, xmax = -104.98, ymax = 39.75),
  verbose = getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE)
)

Arguments

initial_bbox

Numeric vector of length 4 (c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) in EPSG:4326) or any spatial object supported by vantor_as_bbox(). Defaults to downtown Denver, CO.

verbose

Logical. Print status messages. Default is getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE).

Value

A shiny.appobj object.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  run_vantor_demo_app()
}
